title: Brazil's Night of UFOs, 1986 (host summary)
place_text: Four Brazilian states, Brasília and Rio bases

tellings.quote: 1986 in May, you had 21 unidentified objects uh spotted in four different Brazilian states.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that one night in May 1986, 21 unidentified objects were spotted over four Brazilian states, in an event remembered as Brazil's Night of UFOs, with military bases near Brasília and Rio de Janeiro involved. He links the story to a Brazilian officer, Brigadier Octávio Júlio Moreira Lima, and to an official statement from the Brazilian Air Force. Michels tells it as one of Brazil's best-known cases, one he presents as confirmed by the country's own officials.
